capabilities.title: Dynamic secret generation: generate short-lived credentials on demand for databases, cloud providers
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Vault dynamic secrets engines: PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS, Azure, GCP credential generation
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a personal intelligence dashboard; dynamic secrets for infrastructure provisioning is enterprise DevOps scope, not Nexus scope.

capabilities.title: Pluggable secrets engine pattern: mount different secret backends at paths
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Vault secrets engine mount path model
capabilities.reason: Nexus adapts the mount-path organization concept as bounded encrypted record paths. It does not load executable secret backends or claim dynamic infrastructure credentials.

capabilities.title: Transit encryption: encrypt/decrypt data without storing it, via API
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Vault transit engine: encrypt in transit without key management by caller
capabilities.reason: Sensitive VAULT payloads pass through one client-local seal/open boundary using AES-GCM-256, authenticated additional data, a fresh salt and IV per reseal, and no provider or network call.

capabilities.title: Immutable audit log of every secret access and administrative action
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Vault audit devices: structured JSONL audit trail
capabilities.reason: A browser-local envelope cannot honestly provide immutable access auditing: same-origin code can alter storage and logging unlock reads would increase sensitive-state churn. Nexus implements bounded encrypted mutation receipts but does not mislabel them immutable.

capabilities.title: Enterprise-grade HA cluster with integrated raft storage and replication
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a single-user personal tool; HA clustering and enterprise replication are out of scope.
